In July 2026 TerraMar Networks updated its tracpoint mobile app with maintenance log features that let field operators record defect repairs and maintenance activities from mobile devices.
TerraMar Networks deploys the LT42 4G/BLE vehicle tracking unit for continuous real-time cellular data reporting on its tracpoint platform.
At the Fleet Forum Annual Conference in 2025, TerraMar Networks presented a ride-sharing data framework that uses tracpoint telematics data to optimise fleet size and lower emissions.
In September 2025 TerraMar Networks added 4G live video telematics, bringing real-time streaming video and automated trip recordings into its fleet management platform.
TerraMar Networks features UK customers Frylite Group Ltd and H&A Mechanical Services Ltd in its UK case studies.
TerraMar Networks' tracpoint platform gives each user a secure login and supports single sign-on (SSO) through the customer organisation's own sign-in page.
The Tracpoint mobile app's Apple App Store and Google Play privacy declarations state that no data is collected and no data is shared with third parties.
TerraMar Networks states that it helps customers track and manage thousands of assets on land, at sea and in the air.
